headline: Earnings jump, capital plan expands and growth outlook rises
summary_short: Revenue rose 14% to $6,832M and operating EPS grew 24% to $2.23. AEP now expects 2026 operating EPS at or above the high end of $6.25-$6.55 and announced a $100B five-year capital plan.
summary_long: Vertically integrated utilities lifted operating earnings to $721M from $573M, and generation and marketing doubled to $101M. AEP signed 15 GW of new load commitments in the quarter, taking contracted incremental load to 84 GW by 2031. The capital plan of $100B includes about $37B for transmission and $36B for generation, supporting 13%+ rate base growth. New 2027 and 2028 operating EPS ranges are $6.75-$7.05 and $7.40-$7.70.
confidence_notes: Operating earnings are non-GAAP and exclude hedging mark-to-market and wholesale contract items. Deltas computed from the release's year-ago comparatives; EPS uses weighted average basic shares.

drivers.explanation: Vertically Integrated Utilities operating earnings rose $148M and Generation & Marketing rose $52M versus the year-ago quarter; the release does not give a finer cause.
CEO says accelerating electricity demand and large-load customers create investment opportunities, supporting the expanded capital plan and higher growth rate.
